description: KuanJui Huang publishes Python simulations and per-seed results for recurrent node failures and delayed restoration. The September 2026 archive includes analysis and validation scripts, action records and experiments on Barabási–Albert and random-regular networks with 50, 100 and 200 nodes. It also evaluates a SuiteSparse power-network topology and Cogentco from the Internet Topology Zoo. The package is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0 and uses NumPy, SciPy, NetworkX, pandas and Matplotlib. It can test when faster restoration compensates for connectivity loss in network-resilience simulations. The topology experiments do not establish field-calibrated repair rates or service-flow behaviour; operational transferability remains uncertain. Related catalogue record data-internet-topology-zoo covers one upstream topology source. The describing manuscript is identified as submitted, and neither numerical results nor the reproduction scripts were executed.
